name: ADATA Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ADATA Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells memory products worldwide. The company provides computer memory products, solid state drives (SSDs), external SSDs/external hard drives, USB flash drives, memory cards, power banks, USB cables, and AI translators. It also offers axial flux motors, air-cooled motors, liquid-cooled motors, and motor controllers; and LED lighting products. In addition, the company offers notebooks, PC parts and components, peripherals, keyboard, mouse, and headset.
